title: The engine defects this engine has fixed (readiness R1)
description: engine/data/fixed-defects.json, shipped with the engine code it describes. Retro (`incidents prune`) removes an incident whose every occurrence happened on an engine that did not have one of its signature's entries yet. Every entry needs a reproduction test that declares it (@fixes_defect, tests/test_fixed_defects.py); several entries may share one signature.

kind.description: silent = it never stopped anything, so no incident can have its signature (kept for completeness).

commit.description: The fixing commit(s) when known — a commit cannot name itself, so it is filled later.

appeared_as.description: The stop (or its absence) it showed as.
